_comment: FIVB volleyball court, 18 x 9 m. Origin at (end line of the near half) x (far sideline). x runs along the court length: 0 = near end line, 9 = centre line under the net, 18 = far end line. y runs across the width: 0 = far sideline, 9 = near sideline. Attack lines are 3 m from the centre line, i.e. x = 6 and x = 12.
